title: Captain Noah's Sanibel Florida Fishing

services.name: Fishing Sanibel
services.desc: Welcome to Southwest Florida Fishing! Sanibel Island and Ft Myers Beach Florida! With up to 50 different species caught annually, "diverse" might be the easiest one word description of southwest Florida's fishery. Subtropical waters and climate provide a vast mixture of northern and tropical saltwater fish. We fish inshore waters inside Sanibel and Captiva Islands, also the surrounding waters of Pine Island. Our backcountry waters are peppered with hundreds of smaller mangrove islands, thick seagrasses and fields of oysters. These three features provide the basis for marine life and subsequent fishery. Lets go for the Inshore Slam...Snook, Redfish, Sea Trout...add a Tarpon and Grand Slam!
